effects.description: A glowing cyan data packet projectile flying to the right: a small bright cube of light with tiny white binary digits inside, short teal light trail behind it on the left. Chunky clean pixel art for a 64px browser fighting game, cyan, teal and white palette, transparent background, no text.
effects.processing: Alpha cut at 128 and cropped to the visible pixels.
